title: Best Night Moisturiser for Face in India: How to Pick by Skin Type
ex: Light for oily, medium for combination, rich for dry. How to pick the best night moisturiser for your face, how much to use and how to apply it.
rt: Best Night Moisturiser for Face in India by Skin Type | Mirc Glow
rd: Best night moisturiser for face: which texture suits oily, combination and dry skin, 4 picks from ₹399, how much to use and how to apply it at night.
quick: The best night moisturiser is the one whose texture suits your skin: a light gel-cream for oily skin, a medium non-greasy cream for combination skin and a rich cream for dry skin. Use a pea-sized amount on clean, slightly damp skin as the last step at night, and sunscreen in the morning.
facts: Oily skin: half a pea of a light texture
Combination: more on cheeks, less on the T-zone
Dry skin: a rich cream on damp skin
No sunscreen needed in a night moisturiser
